name: frontend-main
what: The main menu: logo and the whole button column

name: frontend-tutorial
what: The Tutorials screen with its five lessons and Back

name: frontend-mods
what: The Mods screen; ideally two or three mods listed, one of them moved (own load order)

name: frontend-credits
what: The credits a few seconds in, the Black Cactus heading and some roles in view

name: frontend-load
what: Load Game, Skirmish tab, with the saved games listed and one selected

name: frontend-load-replays
what: Load Game, Replays tab (menuTest open: load.replays), at least one recording listed with its columns

name: frontend-save
what: The Save Game As window over a running game (in-game menu, then Save Game As)

name: frontend-ingame
what: The in-game menu over a running single-player game, with Game Paused at the top

name: frontend-editlevels
what: The Map Editor's list of maps, one selected

name: frontend-generaleditor
what: The AI General Editor with a portrait, a name and the 14 sliders

name: frontend-campaign
what: The Campaign screen: starting resources on the left, at least one campaign in the list

name: frontend-campaignmap
what: The campaign map of a profile with a few provinces conquered and one chosen, its panel filled (menuTest open: campaignmap.<profile>)

name: frontend-skirmish-players
what: Skirmish lobby, Players tab, on 2 Player 4 Peaks or a 4-player map: you and AI Generals at the positions, a general's portrait and story, the map with its start flags

name: frontend-skirmish-settings
what: Skirmish lobby, Settings tab (menuTest open: skirmish.settings), Standard mode, a map chosen with its preview

name: frontend-skirmish-weather
what: Skirmish lobby, Seasons & Weather tab with Day and night and Seasons and weather on (menuTest open: skirmish.weather:dayNight=1,seasons=1)

name: frontend-skirmish-army
what: Skirmish lobby, Army Enlistment tab in Valhalla mode (menuTest open: skirmish.army:mode=1), a company selected and two or three enlisted

name: frontend-multiplayer
what: The Multiplayer screen, New Game tab, a map chosen and a name typed

name: frontend-multiplayer-games
what: The Multiplayer screen, Find Games tab (menuTest open: multiplayer.games), the local network heading, ideally one game listed

name: frontend-mphost
what: The host's lobby, Players tab, with the guests list and the chat (opened as a screen, no network needed: 'Waiting for players to join' is fine)

name: frontend-mpguest
what: The guest's lobby; best with a host on 127.0.0.1 so that the host's positions show, else the no-connection line

name: frontend-mpload
what: The saved game's lobby for a saved multiplayer game, its saved players listed (menuTest open: mpload.<save>)

name: options-view
what: Options, Graphics > View and fog (menuTest open: options.view)

name: options-sky
what: Options, Graphics > Sky and weather (menuTest open: options.sky)

name: options-lighting
what: Options, Graphics > Shadows and light (menuTest open: options.lighting)

name: options-water
what: Options, Graphics > Water (menuTest open: options.water)

name: options-terrain
what: Options, Graphics > Terrain and grass (menuTest open: options.terrain)

name: options-models
what: Options, Graphics > Models (menuTest open: options.models)

name: options-picture
what: Options, Graphics > Picture (menuTest open: options.picture)

name: options-quality
what: Options, Graphics > Anti-aliasing (menuTest open: options.quality)

name: options-effects
what: Options, Graphics > Effects (menuTest open: options.effects)

name: options-keyboard
what: Options, Controls > Keyboard (menuTest open: options.keyboard), the Camera group at the top

name: options-mouse
what: Options, Controls > Mouse (menuTest open: options.mouse)

name: options-camera
what: Options, Controls > Camera (menuTest open: options.camera)

name: options-interface
what: Options, Interface (menuTest open: options.interface)

name: options-sound
what: Options, Sound (menuTest open: options.sound)

name: options-system
what: Options, System (menuTest open: options.system)

name: options-online
what: Options, Online (menuTest open: options.online), the server field empty with its hint

name: options-agent
what: Options, Agent control (menuTest open: options.agent), switched off
